page: pdp-deck (+ its card on /all, collection-path, pdp-path related, pdp-deck related)
defect: waterproof-solar-deck-step-lights still carries compare_at_price 199.90 vs price 149.90 in the store data. The skin hides it (hdt-compare-at-price{display:none}, .hdt-badge__wrapp{display:none!important}) so no viewport shows 199.90 or the -25% badge, but the DOM of every render still says the product is on sale: the markup ships מחיר רגיל199.90 ₪ and -25%; the same compare-at feeds the cart drawer line and any product feed. A regular price the store never charged is a fabricated claim (BRIEF §3), only masked by CSS.

fix: Shopify Admin → Products → תאורה סולארית עמידה למים לדק ולמדרגות → clear 'Compare-at price' on all 4 variants (SPEC §9). Keep the skin rules as a belt, not as the fix.

page: home, collection-all, collection-path, pdp-rope, pdp-path, pdp-deck
defect: Kalles' price snippet prefixes the CURRENT price with a screen-reader-only «מחיר מבצע» (sale price) on every card and on the PDP price block, for products that are not on sale. Sighted shoppers see nothing; a screen-reader user hears 'sale price 89.90 – 179.90' on 26 non-sale products (27/27 cards on /all, 4 on home, 4 related per PDP, the PDP price itself). That is a sale claim the store cannot back, living in the accessibility tree.
evidence:
verify-after/mirrors/collection-all/index.html, first card: 'מחיר מבצע89.90 ₪ - 179.90 ₪'; text dump of
shows «מחיר מבצע» before every card price (home 4×, /all 27×, path 8×); pdp-rope: 'מחיר מבצע89.90 ₪'.
fix: In snippets/elmsnest-s-skin.liquid, after line 23, add: `.hdt-card-product hdt-price .sr-only,.hdt-product-info__item.hdt-product__price hdt-price .sr-only{display:none} /* Kalles snippets/price.liquid labels the current price 'sale price' even when nothing is on sale */`. The visible price needs no label; the compare-at (when a real one exists) keeps its own «מחיר רגיל» label.

defect: The sort select offers «מומלץ» (recommended) for sort_by=manual, but /collections/all is Shopify's automatic collection with no curated order (Admin API: collectionByHandle("all") = null). The page actually renders alphabetical (the mirror has `title-ascending` selected; fetching /collections/all?sort_by=manual returns the same order as the mirror: led-globe, crystal-ball, edison, warm-step, dual-head…). Choosing «מומלץ» therefore promises a recommendation nobody made. On the four place collections `manual` is the owner's order, so the label is defensible there.
evidence: verify-after/mirrors/collection-all/index.html: '<option value="manual">מומלץ</option> … <option value="title-ascending" selected>א–ב</option>'; collection-all-m-js-fold.png shows the pill «א–ב»; collection-path mirror shows '<option value="manual" selected>מומלץ</option>'.
fix: In sections/elmsnest-s-coll-header.liquid line 100 wrap the option: `{% unless ens_all %}<option value="manual"…>מומלץ</option>{% endunless %}` — or relabel it «סדר החנות» everywhere so it names the source of the order, not a judgement.

defect: The four-card block is headed «מה שנדלק ראשון» (what lights first). Read next to a product grid it implies these four are the first to go / the leaders — a popularity rank the store has no data for (BRIEF §3: no best-seller labels or ranks; P4). The four products are simply an owner pick (product_list).
evidence: home-m-js-full-1.png / home-d-js-full-1.png heading «מה שנדלק ראשון» above outdoor-bidirectional-led-wall-light-ip65, powerful-solar-garden-light, solar-edison-string-lights, solar-firefly-garden-lights; templates/index.json line 71 and sections/elmsnest-s-products.liquid default line 72.
fix: templates/index.json line 71 (and the default on sections/elmsnest-s-products.liquid line 72 / preset line 87): heading → «ארבעה לפתיחה» or «נבחרו לעמוד הבית» — a label that says 'chosen', not 'first'.

page: home, collection-all, collection-path, pdp-rope, pdp-path, pdp-deck (body contact line + footer + header menu note)
defect: Every page promises «לא בטוחים? נבדוק התאמה לפני שתזמינו. לשלוח תמונה של המקום ←» (mailto:info@elmsnest.com) once in the body and again in the footer («לשלוח תמונה של המקום», «כתבו לנו: info@elmsnest.com»), and the mobile menu says «צריכים עזרה? אימייל: info@elmsnest.com». SPEC §1 answer 3 records that elmsnest.com has no MX record (re-measured 2026-09-05): mail to info@ does not arrive. Until DNS is fixed the storefront promises a fit-check on a channel that silently drops the shopper's photo — a claim the store cannot back today. Owner-accepted risk, recorded here so it is not forgotten.

fix: Owner: add MX / a mailbox for info@elmsnest.com (Notion goal #1) before publishing; until then either point snippets/elmsnest-v2-photo-url.liquid and footer-group.json line 212 at an address that receives, or soften the line to «כתבו לנו» without the promise «נבדוק התאמה לפני שתזמינו».
